description: Recorded disambiguation axes for near-neighbour host tools. A mutual 'Do NOT use when' pair is a defect unless one side records the axis that separates the pair here (REQ-554).

manage_archive.axis: Novel archive, export/import, clone/branch, and checkpoints

manage_novel.axis: Novel save lifecycle (create, resume, switch, end, rename, list)

manage_belief.axis: per-entity evidence, belief stances, and the perception ledger

manage_lore.axis: canonical shared world facts and secrets

manage_corpus.axis: external documents and their access state

manage_world.axis: rooms, things, exits, and spatial containment

run_command.axis: parser execution, movement resolution, and intent mapping

manage_diagnostics.axis: health, audit compaction, event log, and verification

manage_scene.axis: scene framing, directive, choices, and oracle

set_badge.axis: switch the seat and access level
